title: A Critical one-component regularity criteria for the three-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations
summary: We establish two critical one-component regularity criteria for the three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations. First, for divergence-free initial data $u_0\in H^1(\mathbb R^3)$, we prove that a strong solution can be continued beyond a finite time $T$ provided that \[ u^3\in L^2\bigl(0,T;\dot B^{3/2}_{2,r}(\mathbb R^3)\bigr) \qquad\text{for some }2<r\leq\infty. \] Second, for every $2<p<\infty$, if $u_0\in\dot H^{1/2}(\mathbb R^3)$ and, for some fixed unit vector $\boldsymbol e\in\mathbb S^2$, \[ u\cdot\boldsymbol e \in L^p\bigl(0,T;\dot H^{1/2+2/p}(\mathbb R^3)\bigr), \]…
